sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The first stage of our state-of-the-art Advanced Manufacturing Research Facility (AMRF) located in Bradfield City Centre, is scheduled to open later this year.
Suppliers of Manufacturing Tooling equipment now have the opportunity to become qualified vendors to the AMRF.
This will enable the AMRF team to develop a robust supply chain to maintain a world class advanced manufacturing facility.
Successful applicants will be on a panel for two years, with an option for a third year extension, for the supply of metrology equipment for the facility.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
For the purposes of this ITR, the term manufacturing tooling refers to a product or item that is used in designing, cutting, shaping, and forming materials that will be used to produce parts and components during the manufacturing process, and are typically items that are regularly replaced or replenished because they are used, worn out, or exhausted over time.
The proposed scope of the manufacturing tooling procurement panel will include the following (but not limited to):
o Cutting Tools for milling, turning, drilling and tapping, grinding, or any accessories that are required in conjunction with cutting tools
o Toolholders for milling or turning, including any accessories that are required in conjunction with the use of toolholders
o Workholding for milling or turning, including any accessories that are required in conjunction with the use of workholding.
o Machine Calibration and Measurement Devices
o Deburring Tools
o Tooling that doesn’t fall under any of the aforementioned categories, relating to precision machining, precision inspection, composites, or additive manufacturing
